note: Starting values of plan.md ('Performance Goals'), measured on the Linux host of the campaign with .specstride/features/109-harness-seam/gates/proofs/T105-measure.mjs and recorded here. Median of repeated runs; every value is hermetic: no probe, no model call, no paid call, no external network.

host.method: median of 25 runs (15 for the sweep), performance.now()

registryBuild.what: createRegistry from 20 descriptor sources, without probes

overlayBuild.what: buildOverlay of a declaration with two variables and one seed, in a throwaway directory

sweep.what: sweep at start-up with 100 marked trees in the temporary directory

suiteRunTime.what: one run of the conformance suite (HC-01 to HC-17) on the sample outside the core
